This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a symmetric arrangement of 8 [[triangular prism]]s, aligned in pairs with the axes of three-fold rotational symmetry of an [[octahedron]]. It results from composing the two [[Chirality (mathematics)|enantiomorphs]] of the [[compound of four triangular prisms|compound of 4 triangular prisms]].
